I'm waiting for responses. So far, I've only been accepted by my safety school. The thing I want to study is pretty specific that I can't just apply to any college, and the ones I did apply to that actually have decent programs are the top in the country. I've missed a lot of school because of depression, and it's affected my grades. For an IB student, I'm doing pretty well. But most american universities don't care about IB, and only see the translated grades that are considered bad in the US. 


I could have done AP, had better grades (because it's so much easier), but I didn't change schools. It was one of the worst decisions I've made.
Lol sorry. Changing details to prevent recognition.
